column2: Tom felt a pang of jealousy when his best friend got the new bike.
column3: 好朋友拿到新腳踏車時，湯姆心裡湧起一陣妒意。
column5: jealous 的名詞；看別人有新玩具，心裡酸酸的就是它

column2: The old clock tower is a famous landmark that visitors can spot from far away.
column3: 古老的鐘塔是著名的地標，遊客從很遠就能看見。
column4: famous local landmark (著名的當地地標)
column5: land 陸地 + mark 記號：陸地上的記號，就是地標

column2: The guest lecturer spoke for an hour about volcanoes to a packed hall.
column3: 客座講師對著座無虛席的大廳講了一小時的火山。
column4: guest lecturer speaks (客座講師演講)
column5: lecture 演講 + er 人：站在台上講課的人

column2: My grandmother told us the legend of a dragon that guarded the lake.
column3: 奶奶跟我們說了一個巨龍守護湖泊的傳說。
column4: local legend says (當地傳說提到)
column5: 諧音「累井」：一代代傳下去，講到累的老故事

column2: Every camera has its limitations, so it cannot take clear photos in total darkness.
column3: 每台相機都有極限，所以在全黑中拍不出清楚的照片。
column4: know your limitations (認清自己的極限)
column5: limit 界線 + ation：到了界線就過不去，就是限度

column2: After gym class, Mei put her wet shoes in her locker.
column3: 體育課後，小梅把濕鞋子放進她的置物櫃。
column4: school locker room (學校置物櫃室)
column5: lock 上鎖 + er：能上鎖的櫃子

column2: She rubbed some lotion on her dry hands before going outside in winter.
column3: 冬天出門前，她在乾燥的雙手上抹了一些乳液。
column5: 諧音「樓繡」：乳液抹上去滑滑的，像走樓梯不卡手

column2: The dog showed great loyalty by waiting at the station for its owner every day.
column3: 這隻狗每天在車站等主人，展現了極大的忠誠。
column5: loyal 忠心的 + ty：想到忠犬小八

column2: A long hot bath is a real luxury after a tiring week.
column3: 疲累的一週過後，泡個長長的熱水澡真是種享受。
column4: a rare luxury (難得的奢侈享受)
column5: 諧音「拉可舒瑞」：享受起來好舒服的奢華

column2: Can I help you, ma'am? the shop assistant asked the woman politely.
column3: 「女士，需要幫忙嗎？」店員有禮貌地問那位婦人。
column5: 諧音「媽姆」：用來稱呼像媽媽年紀的女士

column2: Madam, your table is ready, said the waiter with a small bow.
column3: 「夫人，您的桌位好了。」服務生微微鞠躬說。
column5: 諧音「馬燈」：古時對夫人的稱呼；注意別跟 mad 生氣搞混

column2: It took her twenty minutes to put on her makeup before the school dance.
column3: 學校舞會前，她花了二十分鐘化妝。
column5: make 做 + up 上去：把臉「做」上去，就是化妝

column2: The manufacturer recalled thousands of toys after finding a loose part.
column3: 廠商發現一個零件鬆脫後，召回了數千個玩具。
column5: manu 手 + fact 做 + er：用手做出東西的人或廠商

column2: He trained for months to run his first marathon in Taipei.
column3: 他訓練了好幾個月，要在台北跑他的第一場馬拉松。
column5: 傳說希臘士兵從 Marathon 村一路跑回雅典報喜訊

column2: She wrote notes in the margin of the page to remember her ideas.
column3: 她在頁面的邊緣寫下筆記，好記住自己的想法。
column4: in the margin (在頁邊空白處)
column5: 諧音「馬金」：馬拉到邊邊，金邊就是邊緣

column2: The mechanic checked the brakes and said our car was safe to drive.
column3: 技工檢查了煞車，說我們的車可以安全行駛。
column5: machine 機器的人：修機器的就是 mechanic

column2: The judge showed mercy and let the young man go home with a warning.
column3: 法官心存憐憫，只警告那名年輕人就讓他回家。
column5: 諧音「麥西」：賣西瓜給你不收錢，就是仁慈

column2: The plan has several merits, such as low cost and easy setup.
column3: 這個計畫有幾項優點，例如成本低又容易設置。
column5: 想成「賣瑞特」：賣得好是因為有優點

column2: A young messenger ran through the village carrying the king's letter.
column3: 一位年輕的送信人帶著國王的信，跑過村莊。
column5: message 訊息 + er：幫你傳訊息的人

column2: The Ministry of Education announced new rules for summer school classes.
column3: 教育部宣布了暑期輔導課的新規定。
column5: mini 小官員們組成的部門；英國稱「部」用 ministry

column2: The twins' mischief included hiding their father's slippers in the garden.
column3: 雙胞胎的淘氣包括把爸爸的拖鞋藏在花園裡。
column4: full of mischief (滿肚子鬼點子)
column5: 諧音「米絲雞夫」：偷吃米絲的調皮雞

column2: It was his misfortune to lose his wallet on the very first day of the trip.
column3: 他很不幸，旅行第一天就弄丟了錢包。
column5: mis 壞 + fortune 運氣：壞運氣

column2: Praise from her teacher gave Amy the motivation to keep practicing the piano.
column3: 老師的稱讚給了艾咪繼續練鋼琴的動力。
column5: motor 馬達 + ation：讓人動起來的馬達

column2: A mudslide blocked the mountain road after three days of heavy rain.
column3: 連下三天大雨後，土石流堵住了山路。
column4: a deadly mudslide (嚴重的土石流)
column5: mud 泥 + slide 滑：泥巴像溜滑梯滑下山

column2: On the form, write your name, age, and nationality in the boxes.
column3: 在表格上，請把姓名、年齡和國籍填進格子裡。
column5: nation 國家 + ality：你屬於哪個國家

column2: Parents drop their toddlers at the nursery before heading to work each morning.
column3: 家長每天早上上班前，把幼兒送到托兒所。
column5: nurse 照顧 + ry：照顧小寶寶或小樹苗的地方

column2: These strong nylon ropes are used for climbing and camping.
column3: 這些堅固的尼龍繩用於攀岩和露營。
column5: 諧音「耐龍」：很耐用的龍鬚線，尼龍很耐拉

column2: Careful observation of the ants showed that they always follow the same path.
column3: 對螞蟻的仔細觀察顯示，牠們總是走同一條路徑。
column5: observe 觀察 + ation：看得很仔細

column2: She took offense at his rude joke and left the table.
column3: 她被他無禮的玩笑冒犯，離開了餐桌。
column4: take offense at (對…感到被冒犯)
column5: of 離 + fense 打：一拳打過來，被冒犯了

column2: Nobody could predict the outcome of the final match.
column3: 沒有人能預測決賽的結果。
column5: out 出來 + come 來：最後走出來的結果

column2: A panel of three judges chose the winner of the singing contest.
column3: 三位評審組成的小組選出了歌唱比賽的優勝者。
column5: 想成一排排平平的木板，圍成小組開會的桌子

column2: Active participation in class discussions can raise your final grade.
column3: 積極參與課堂討論可以提高你的學期成績。
column5: part 一部分：成為活動的一部分就是參加

column2: In "broken window," the word "broken" is a past participle.
column3: 在「broken window」中，「broken」是過去分詞。
column5: part 一部分：同時有動詞與形容詞兩部分的性質

column2: The two bakeries formed a partnership to sell cakes online.
column3: 兩家麵包店建立合作關係，在網路上賣蛋糕。
column4: a business partnership (商業夥伴關係)
column5: partner 夥伴 + ship 關係：夥伴之間的關係

column2: The child picked up a smooth pebble from the stream and kept it.
column3: 孩子從溪裡撿起一顆光滑的小圓石並收藏起來。
column4: a smooth pebble (光滑的小石子)
column5: 諧音「掰剝」：小石頭掰一掰、剝一剝都剝不開

column2: The penalty for parking here is a fine of one thousand dollars.
column3: 在這裡停車的處罰是罰款一千元。
column5: 諧音「噴囊提」：犯規被噴罵，還要受罰

column2: Only one percent of the students forgot to bring their homework.
column3: 只有百分之一的學生忘了帶作業。
column5: per 每 + cent 一百：每一百個裡的幾個

column2: A large percentage of the class chose pizza for the party.
column3: 班上很大比例的同學選了披薩當派對餐點。
column5: percent 百分之一，加 age 就是整體的百分比

column2: The painter worked for years in search of perfection in every brushstroke.
column3: 畫家花了好幾年，追求每一筆都盡善盡美。
column5: per 完全 + fect 做：完全做好，就是完美

column2: A single pink petal floated down from the cherry tree onto my book.
column3: 一片粉紅花瓣從櫻花樹上飄落在我的書上。
column5: 諧音「陪頭」：花瓣陪著花朵的頭
